content: MDN HTMLElement.focus(): by default the browser scrolls the newly-focused element into view (preventScroll:false default); focus({preventScroll:true}) disables scrolling (Baseline widely available). focusVisible option is newer/variable. Implication for h1-on-route-swap: default focus() scroll doubles as the list-top reset on view switch; when a saved-location restore must win, do NOT focus the h1 at all rather than fighting scroll.
